title: Unit 16 Consolidation: The Pluperfect Subjunctive and Ifigenia
goal: Review the pluperfect subjunctive: forms, past wishes, unreal conditions and judgments, and read a short text about Teresa de la Parra and Ifigenia.
grammar: Review of the pluperfect subjunctive: forms, past wishes, de haber and judgments

items: I can use the pluperfect subjunctive in conditions, wishes and judgments about the past.
I can say that I wish something had happened, with ojalá.
I can use de haber + participle for a condition without si.
I can say what would have been better, or what surprised me, about the past.
I can read a short text about Teresa de la Parra and her novel Ifigenia.
